name: Threatening
overview: The biblical teaching on threatening reveals a tension between justice and mercy. The Old Testament law, exemplified by the principle of 'an eye for an eye' (Exodus 21:24; Matthew 5:38), establishes a foundation for measured justice, yet the Psalms remind believers that God is our refuge and strength in times of trouble (Psalms 46:1). Proverbs warns against the damage caused when the righteous fall before the wicked (Proverbs 25:26), highlighting the spiritual peril of succumbing to threats. Jesus’ own experience of temptation (Matthew 4:1) underscores the reality of facing threats, but also points to reliance on God’s Spirit for strength and victory.
